overall_summary: Husband-wife/marriage relationship dynamics significantly outperform all other topics (achieving ~1.7k-1.8k views vs 20-300 views for family/generic shayari). Focus on everyday post-marriage silent disconnects and unexpressed feelings.

winning_patterns.evidence: Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya? (1,770 views) and Wife Emotional Video (1,679 views) are the top 2 performing videos by a massive margin.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on real-life married dynamics, silent unspoken sacrifices, and evolving dynamics after marriage.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles framing a relatable dilemma ('Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?') drove high engagement and retention.
winning_patterns.action: Start videos with direct, relatable everyday questions about relational habits.

weak_patterns.evidence: DIL TAPAKING poetic shayari like 'षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' got only 21 views, Sister videos got 19-140 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract poetic lines or overused sibling tropes that lack specific emotional situational hooks.
